x: Thus, Oscar Horwood, a schoolmate, Harry Goodfellow, Ernie Musselbrook (then in Kennington Harriers), Dick Best and others were his contemporaries; and Harry soon showed himself a useful performer and displayed his tremendous sense of team spirit and solidarity, combined with a desire to be of help…
But even in his last illness his desire was to see the Belgravians of the earlier days with whom he had worked so well, and Harry Goodfellow, C.

We also regret to announce the death of Harry Goodfellow, a Life Member and a member of the Club for over 40 years. Many will recall his jovial rotund figure, and his hard work for the Club in past years.

Harry Evans, the interim President, took the chair and after a few well chosen words, the assembly stood for a few moments as a token of respect to our late President Frank Elson, and a Life Member H.
